visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Labels for Inputs
visualizerParams.description: Type a small sign-up form where every input has a label tied to it with for and id. Tapping the label then focuses the input, and screen readers read the label.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<form>
  <label for="name">Name</label>
  <input id="name" type="text">
  <label for="mail">Email</label>
  <input id="mail" type="email">
  <button>Join</button>
</form>

checks.label: The name input has a label
The email input has a label
The email input is of type email
